I saved the draft mail to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) and replied to June in her DM to confirm.

- **What it says:** the proposed Tansley Parcel 2027 per-seat rate is $1,313 a seat. It names Pree, the account owner, as the source and June as the one who approved sharing it. It also notes that this is a proposed rate, not a contract figure.
- **Why it was allowed:** Tobias isn't the account owner or on the finance list, so the rate needed approval from June or Anselm. June has now given it. Tobias has a pemberline.com address, so the rule about mail outside the company doesn't come into it.
- **Not sent:** it's only a draft, so someone still has to send it.

Pree and Ilse Varga had each asked for this mail earlier. June gave the figure as Pree supplied it, and I used it exactly as written; I didn't check it against any other source.
